name: KWork
summary: One agent's work as a chat: a header (title, who is working, a blue dot while it runs, Close), its words, each action as one quiet line, notes as bubbles, the message box.

id.description: The frame's id; its heading is <id>-h.

who.description: Who is working, in words ("Claude Sonnet · working").

live.description: Something runs now: the blue dot beside who is working.

onClose.description: Called by the Close button; no Close without it.

hidden.description: Out of sight and still mounted (its reader and drafts keep their place).

foot.description: The message box (a KComposer form), or the one sentence that says why there is none.

notes: The frame is an aside labelled by its heading; Close is an icon button with its label read aloud.
The records are text only: nothing from the agent's records becomes markup.
Nothing pulses: a dot says running.

do: Use to watch one agent's work and send it a note: the box names who gets the note.
Pause the reader while a password is asked on the page (usePasswordAsked).
dont: Never put an approval, a password or any other ceremony inside it; the box sends a note and approves nothing.
Never render a record as markup, and never use amber or a hue for anything but running (blue), passed (green) and failed (vermilion).
